notes.title: Unknowz Update - 1.0.3
notes.content: [h1]Thank you for playing Unknowz![/h1][h3]Here’s what’s new in this update:[/h3][list][*][p]General game optimization (around 1ms per frame gained, resulting in up to 10 additional FPS depending on your configuration).[/p][/*][/list][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3826300/Unknowz/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Update Unknowz - 1.0.2
notes.content: [h1]Thank you for playing Unknowz![/h1][h3] Here’s what’s new in this update:[/h3][list][*][p]Added explosion sound when kamikaze enemies die.[/p][/*][*][p]Removed an element that allowed players to skip the final shark puzzle without solving it.[/p][/*][*][p]Added audio feedback during the shark sequence.[/p][/*][*][p]The shark now resumes chasing players if you reload a game in the middle of its level.[/p][/*][*][p]Enemy damage is now displayed when they are hit.[/p][/*][*][p]General game optimization (textures, ticking actors, shadows, lights). Game size reduced by 300MB and stability improved.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3826300/Unknowz/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Minor Update Unknowz 1.0.1
notes.content:
[h1]Thank you for playing Unknowz![/h1][h3]
Here’s what’s new in this update:[/h3][list][*][p]Fluid new transitions between menus and during gameplay.[/p][/*][*][p]The [b]"Secrets of the Ancients"[/b] achievement now works correctly.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Minor known issue:[/h3][list][*][p]The second controller's [i]Back[/i] action in menus still does not function.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3826300/Unknowz/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: 🏴‍☠️ Set Sail, Crew!
notes.content: [h1][b]The wait is over, Captain![/b] [/h1][p][/p][p]After months of hard work, our pirate adventure is finally ready for all brave sailors out there and it’s [b]LIVE on Steam[/b]!  [/p][p][/p][h2]⚓ [b]What awaits you:[/b][/h2][p][/p][list][*][p]A unique duo: a living pirate and his undead companion  [/p][/*][*][p]Endless waves of skeletons hungry for your bones  [/p][/*][*][p]Explosive action (in every sense of the word)  [/p][/*][*][p]An epic escape from the cursed island  [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]💡 [b]Developed by a small student team in just 9 months[/b] [/h2][p][/p][p]This project was crafted with passion by a small crew of game design students, working side-by-side to bring this cursed island to life. Every detail, from the first line of code to the final explosion, was made with love (and a bit of rum).  [/p][p][/p][h2]💬 [b]Got feedback or facing an issue?[/b][/h2][p][/p][p]We’re here for you!  [/p][p]If you encounter any bug, technical issue, or simply want to share your ideas, feel free to reach out to us through the Steam Community Hub or our contact channels.  [/p][p]We love chatting with players and hearing your stories – every message helps us improve and make the game even better!  [/p][p][/p][h2]⛵ [b]Ready to set sail?[/b][/h2][p][/p][p]Download the game now and join the adventure!  [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45665048/62d65e2aa69fc6e9e60c96c10ca7169967f3e5c8.png"][/img][/p]
